newsitem.title: USA: Tommy Hilfiger in licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: Tommy Hilfiger in licensing pact.

text.p: Tommy Hilfiger Corp, the trendy sportswear maker, said Friday it had signed a licensing agreement with Revman Industries Inc to produce and market a line of linens, bedding, bath products and related accesories.
Courtney Moss, a spokesman for Tommy Hilfiger, declined to disclose financial terms of the deal.
Tommy Hilfiger said the home furnishings line will debut at upscale department stores in June 1998 and in select catalogs nationwide.
It said it planned to expand the line through additional licensing agreements for related products such as tabletop, upholstered items and wall coverings.
Revman is a leading supplier of home fashion textile products. Its brands include Laura Ashley.
